title: Malevolent
subtitle: Cosmic-horror mystery with enough momentum to make the darkness feel athletic.
description: A horror serial following Arthur Lester, an amnesiac private investigator forced to navigate eldritch mysteries with the help of a voice inside his head.

length.label: Official site publishes a continuing numbered-part structure and active release history through 2026.

archiveTake: A strong escalation pick when the listener wants more occult intensity without losing narrative drive.

similarReasons.the-white-vault: Keeps the dread intense while turning the threat colder and more environmental.
similarReasons.tower-4: A quieter paranoia branch if the voice-driven unease is the part you want to keep.
similarReasons.impact-winter: A more overtly cinematic escalation if the intensity matters more than the occult frame.
similarReasons.archive-81: A stranger signal-horror branch once you want the mystery to become more structurally weird.
